snippet.title: Warside - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The wait is finally over, Warside launches on Steam today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368300/Warside/

From all of us at LAVABIRD and First Break Labs, we are so excited for you to have the opportunity to finally experience Warside in all of its glory! Best of luck, Commander.

Welcome to Warside, the fast-paced turn-based tactics game. With a single-player story campaign, multiplayer support, and a built-in map editor, the fight for victory never ends. Choose your Commander, assemble your forces, and battle your way to victory.

Visit us at:
https://firstbreaklabs.com/ 

Follow us on our socials!
